note: What a server sends to stop an animation a unit is playing. The header names the unit.

bits.name: unusedLow
bits.note: A client ignores these; a server sends zero.

bits.name: unlock
bits.note: Set to release the unit's animation lock in every case. Clear releases it only where the unit's own state allows; the animation stops either way.

bits.name: unusedMid
bits.note: A client ignores these; a server sends zero.

bits.name: blend
bits.note: Set to put the unit's animation into a second blend state, which a client applies only where one of its own settings is on. What that state changes is not recorded.

bits.name: unusedHigh
bits.note: A client ignores these; a server sends zero.

revisions.note: No name is carried: a client stops whatever animation the unit is playing, blending out over a fixed time.

bits.name: fade
bits.note: Set where the animation fades out.

bits.name: ignoreLock
bits.note: Set where a lock on the animation is ignored.

bits.name: stopAll
bits.note: Set where every animation stops when the name below is empty.

fields.name: animation
fields.note: The animation's name, ended by a zero byte, or empty.
